deciders.trade_off: the lane's design owner (Borges for EngramManager); Lei informed

design: paired interleaved baseline/owner per iteration inside one run; runs are the unit
metric: sequential p50 per run (ms), owner path vs baseline path
population: installed layout, real-store copy, one (SQLite build, exclusion setting) cell per JSONL pair; the cell is named in the JSONL file name
verdict_rule: B1 (engram-alpha#3740): PASS when the 90% CI upper bound of the owner/baseline sequential-p50 ratio is <= 1.03 at the planned n (6 runs); TRADE_OFF when the ratio estimate is <= 10% above 1 (<= 1.10) and the upper bound is above 1.03, decided by the lane's design owner with the structural or safety gain named in writing, Lei informed; BLOCK when the ratio estimate is beyond 1.10. Absolute rider: 0.5 ms per fire. metricgate v0.1 has no absolute-margin field, so the 0.5 ms is a guardrail read by the design owner from the report's estimate, not computed by the gate.
